name: Medium Turquoise
lede: Medium Turquoise is a clear blue-green from the X11 and CSS color lists, a neighbor of turquoise.

sections.title: A list name
sections.body:
Medium Turquoise is one of the colors in the X11 Color Set, with the hex code #48D1CC [1]. It became a CSS keyword, `mediumturquoise`, in the W3C's CSS Color Module Level 3 [2]. Our books give it no history beyond that entry, so the name's origin is undocumented here [1].

It sits between [[pale-turquoise]] and [[dark-turquoise]] in the same list, around the family hue of [[turquoise]] [3]. The ISCC-NBS system of 1955 would call it a "brilliant bluish green" (block 159), 5.0 CIEDE2000 units away, and the nearest name from our learning set is *Turquoise* itself, at the same distance [3].

sections.title: Field notes
sections.body: Only one painting in our 23,781-painting archive carries it, a work dated 1783, as photographed [4]. These are photographs of aged, varnished paintings, so read the match as a screen color and not a pigment [4].
